sections.controlled_paraphrase: The referee observes and announces whether an object ball is frozen to a cushion or the cue ball. Without an announcement, the ball is treated as not frozen.

sections.locator: Multiple cue-tip contacts and Double Hit
sections.controlled_paraphrase: The cue tip may contact the cue ball only once in one stroke. More than one contact is a foul. For a very close cue/object arrangement, object contact before tip separation is a foul, subject to a stated light-graze presumption.
An obvious push that extends tip contact distance or duration beyond an instantaneous strike is a foul.

sections.locator: Cue ball frozen to legal object ball
sections.controlled_paraphrase: When the cue ball is declared frozen to a legal object ball, direction is unrestricted. Direct object-ball movement is not presumed a double hit when the stroke action is obvious, but an obvious push remains a foul.

When an object ball is declared frozen to a cushion and the prerequisite legal cushion condition has not already been met, legality requires the frozen object to leave and re-contact a cushion, another ball to contact a cushion, or a ball to be pocketed.

uniquely_determined_rules: more than one cue-tip contact with the cue ball during one stroke is a foul
cue-ball contact with a close object ball before the cue tip leaves the cue ball is within the double-hit rule
a push is distinct from an instantaneous strike and remains prohibited for a declared frozen cue/object arrangement
frozen-ball rule treatment requires a referee announcement and absence of an announcement means not frozen
a declared frozen cue/object arrangement changes the double-hit presumption but does not legalize an obvious push
a declared frozen object/cushion arrangement has leave-and-recontact, other-ball-cushion, or pocket alternatives
not_numerically_or_operationally_defined: the separation threshold for very close
the trajectory, angle, speed, impulse, or duration threshold for lightly grazes
the contact-distance or contact-duration threshold separating an instantaneous strike from an obvious push
the kinematic threshold for an obvious stroke action or obvious push
the geometric tolerance and authoritative sample time used by a referee to declare a ball frozen
whether pocket jaws satisfy the cushion alternatives in clause 15.2
the exact machine predicate represented by the prerequisite phrase about a completed legal cushion contact

safe_existing_raw_observations: one accepted or rejected CueImpactInput and CueContactResult pair at launch
regular-contact impulse, pre/post velocity, contact arm and normal without a duration claim
coupled-contact microstep ordinal, time, cue position, cue velocity, cue acceleration, compression, force, cumulative impulse, constraint contacts and release/failure status
physics ball-ball, rail and pocket contacts with solver provenance after launch
initial geometry candidates within the configured solver penetration slop
forbidden_inferences_from_existing_data: one modeled initial contact means the cue tip touched only once during the whole stroke
coupled microtrace duration is a complete full-shot push duration
geometry within solver slop is a referee frozen-ball declaration
positive impulse or long contact alone is an obvious push
object movement directly from the coupled island is automatically a legal frozen-ball stroke
any rail or pocket-jaw record satisfies the clause 15.2 cushion alternative
policy_independent_observations.reason: The input and solver model one launch transaction and stop simulating the cue tip after release. A complete stroke-level contact count, re-contact absence, referee declaration, obviousness classification, and clause 15.2 lifecycle therefore cannot be attested without new authoritative inputs and sampling contracts.

double_hit.resolved_machine_predicate: complete full-stroke cue-tip interval count greater than one

declaration_commit: validate referee capability, actor, relation, ball and cushion identity, live rules revision and state hash
atomically persist one frozen or explicitly-not-frozen declaration before shot acceptance
bind the declaration to one exact pre-shot state and expire it on shot completion, reset, rerack or state conflict
shot_telemetry_commit: begin one stroke observation before the first possible cue-tip contact
append canonical non-overlapping cue-tip intervals and cue/object/cushion lifecycle records
finish only after the authoritative stroke observation boundary and mark incomplete on any gap
publish ShotFacts only after validation of identity, ordering, finiteness, provenance and completeness
adjudication_commit: require the exact current declaration when a frozen-ball exception or obligation is evaluated
require complete stroke telemetry before machine double-hit evaluation
require a selected policy or explicit referee decision for close-ball presumption, push obviousness and unresolved cushion semantics
apply foul, turn transfer, ball in hand, revision, journal and declaration expiry atomically
future_atomic_contract.failure_rollback: state, declaration, facts, revision, actor, turn, ball-in-hand, journals and receipts remain byte-equivalent to the pre-call state
future_atomic_contract.exact_retry: returns the original ACK without duplicating declaration, intervals, facts, foul or revision

forbidden_scope: production source edits in this design-gate task
treating coupled microsteps as a complete full-stroke tip-contact trace
treating geometry-detected contact as a referee frozen-ball declaration
guessing very-close, light-graze, obvious-push, duration, distance, jaw or sampling tolerances
adjudicating from incomplete cue-tip or frozen-cushion telemetry
promoting any scoped audit row above MISSING
